title: Swordchants!
description: Adds 3 new enchants for the sword!
body:
This mod adds 3 new sword enchants! They are:

Attract - Reverse knockback, bring entities towards you!

Launch - Send entities up to 6 blocks into the air!

Reach - Allows you to hit entities up to 5 blocks away!

There is also a config to toggle certain enchants on and off.


If there are any issues or you have a mod request, send it to my Reddit:
https://www.reddit.com/user/Both_Cardiologist118/comments/1s788d1/all_suggestions_from_yt
